notes.title: Rumble Club Season 3 blasts onto the scene!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937603/3afee2999c348f3d3ba1942de1e5a68627917325.jpg
Rumble Club Season 3 is here and it’s a blast! 

Here’s everything new in Rumble Club’s military-themed third season: 

5 New Gadgets

 Mortar - Launch a bouncing mortar bomb that explodes when it expires. 
 Punchie Buggie - Drive the Punchie Buggie and lay explosive mines.
 Minigun - Fire a burst of bullets that slow and knock back enemies. 
 Shovel - Whirl around the Shovel to send Punchies around you flying. Charge up to disarm. 
 Rocket Launcher - Fire explosive rockets that explode when they hit. 
New Rumble Pass Cosmetics
Progress on the Rumble Pass and Super Rumble Pass to unlock the Battle Garb skin, Spec Ops Accessory, exclusive Paints, and more. Super+ owners can also unlock the Future Fighter accessory. 

Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue with some islands forming as tiles fall in Beach Ballin’ 
Punch on and let us know what you think about Season 3 here on Steam and in our Discord!

notes.title: Rumble Club v1.3 - New Mode, New Map, New Jump Button!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937603/1852f8771882185c3dbc493b1e066fd4bc0246e0.gif

We hope you’re thirsty for another game update, Punchies! Rumble Club 1.3 has just gone live with a new way to play - a new game mode, a new map, and a whole new jumping mechanic. 

New Mode - Juiced Up
In this variant to Punch Royale, crates and defeated players drop Juice Boxes which increase your punch power and punch resistance. Collect Juice Boxes for more power, or pick up a gadget to counter a more powerful enemy. In addition to Juice Boxes, punchies can now also jump in Juiced Up! Use a new button to leap into the air to clear obstacles, avoid punches, or save yourself from falling into the goop. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937603/e7371a741b5e11f4e6bd0b7adc86b30288ab523b.gif
New Map - Finish Line
A new map has entered the rotation as well, a sports arena called Finish Line. This one is in preparation for the first annual Punchie Games coming later this summer, stay tuned for more on that event!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937603/d2db79e1d5765d2e338c6c9468f94d14dc2a16ea.gif
Bug fixes

 Lots of improvements to connectivity.
 Fixed a bug where initial one-time spawned gadgets would not fall into the goop with their tiles.
 Walk the Planks and Old Punchie Town now properly support spawns in 10v10
 Fixed a bug where Fans didn’t fall into the goop on Walk the Planks
 Fixed a bug where swinging hammers didn’t fall into the goop on Walk the Planks
 Fixing a bad scoring zone in King of the Hill on Punchington Castle
 Fixed an issue causing knockback in Spaced Out to be reduced in gravity domes
 Fixed south controller face button triggering Play Again after matches
 Fixed Korean characters failing to display correctly in some cases
 Fixed sword swing SFX not triggering with the Sword and Board
 Fixed some cosmetic skins not displaying their names
 Fixed an edge case allowing private matches to start with too many players

Balance

 Updated Hamster Ball ability to slam down to the ground rather than jump if you are already airborne when activating it.

Let us know what you think about the new mode and mechanics here on Steam and in our Discord.

notes.title: Rumble Club Season 2 is Live!
notes.content:
Welcome to Season 2!

The time has come, Punchies of the Realm!  Season 2 of Rumble Club is now live, and you can jump in with our new game mod and fantasy themed map, gadgets, and cosmetics now. 

We shared initial details on what’s new here earlier in the month, but read on for every new detail, plus patch notes in v1.2. 
[previewyoutube=piGYJXO8G1I;full][/previewyoutube]
New Season 2 Content
Space gadgets from the Launch season have been swapped out with five new tools: 

 Sword and Board - Tap to swing your sword knocking enemies up and then backwards, applying strikes! Hold down to block attacks. 
 Crossbow - Fire a plunger from this crossbow for a single shot, or Charge up to fire a spread shot of 5 plungers!
 Faerie Wings - Fly through the air and sprinkle Faerie Dust before you come down with a crash, knocking enemies away and applying strikes. Pick up Faerie Dust to get a speed boost!
 Horsie - Ride into battle with your lance on the Horsie. Hit enemies with the end of your lance to apply 3 strikes!
 Ogre King - Go Ham with the Ogre King. Smash your opponents with a big ground slam in a long, narrow cone, sending them flying and applying up to 3 strikes!

By popular demand, Tournaments have been added to Rumble Club! 

 Play in rotating Tournaments this season, earn big rewards for your wins, and make progress on the seasonal Tournament Track.
 Tournaments can have a variety of themes, game modes, maps, and round counts.
 Placing well in Tournaments gives you rewards, including progress on the Tournament Track
 Complete the Track this season to unlock the Jester Hat and to get Frosty, the Baby Dragon!

Introducing Rumble Run - Play multiple game mode rounds in a row, gain points for your placement, and win!

 Qualifying Rounds - Play multiple rounds of different game modes, earn points based on your placement at the end of the match. The lowest cumulative scores get cut between rounds.
 Final Round - Once the final round has been reached, it’s a winner-take-all scenario. Win the last match, and you win the whole Rumble Run!

New Player Rewards:

 Get rewards, including cosmetics, for playing for your first seven days! Existing players, don’t worry, you’ll get to collect these rewards too.

New maps! We are introducing 5 new maps, all of which support all 6 game modes. 

 Punchington Castle
 Desserted Island 
 Old Punchie Town
 Dungeon Depths
 Walk the Planks

All of these maps are available in private lobbies. Punchington Castle is a full size map which also appears in public matches. The other four maps are smaller maps which appear in our new tournament system.

Patch Notes
Balance:

 Updated throwable balls to throw a bit less downward causing them to not bounce so high into the air on a throw. Hopefully this makes using these items a bit more reliable.
 Slightly increased the size and power of the basic rolling hamster ball knockback. In particular we hope this helps with Gadget Game stall out when players have the Hamster Ball.
 Decreased Turn speed with deployed umbrella by 10% to make pinning someone with it a bit more difficult.
 Now that we can tune the magnet post throw cooldown time we are adjusting it to find the best balance for this gadget. We have Increased the post throw cooldown on magnet by 10%.
 The balance of punching a knocked out enemy vs picking up and throwing is constantly on a knife's edge. This is an area that we are constantly working on so expect changes here to be small so we can dial in this behavior. Right now it feels like the value of throwing has fewer intended situations than we hoped so we are increasing the remaining knockout time on throws by 0.05 seconds to try and increase the value of picking up and throwing.
 To give the Magic Donut some love we have increased the # of strikes it applies from 1 to 2. Go get your sweet tooth on. 

Bug fixes:

 Fixed a tile that didn’t drop on Spaced Out by preventing players from standing on the edge of it.
 Fixed Trophy Track and Crown Track progress bars disappearing when maxed out.
 You may have noticed some stray 1-strike crates filled with mysterious goodies accidentally scattered on some of our maps. They have been removed…for now.


We hope you dig Season 2’s new modes and content. Please keep the feedback coming, we’re listening and considering all your suggestions for future updates. If you’re not in our Discord yet, hop on in!

notes.title: Rumble Club v1.1.1 is live!
notes.content:
We are hard at work preparing for Season 2, bringing Fantasy-themed cosmetics, gadgets, and a new map on June 24th.  But in the meantime, we have a new update for you all. 

This one includes a new map called Rumble Athletic Club, changes to earning Crown Fragments in team game modes, as well as a batch of fixes and balance changes. 

[previewyoutube=ReYlXeS5TIY;full][/previewyoutube]

Read on for everything new in Rumble Club v1.1.1: 

New Features

 Earn Crown Fragments in team game modes. Get 20 Fragments to get a Crown!
 Check the new Game Modes daily to get extra Rumble Pass progress.

New Map

 Rumble Athletic Club - Try out this new gym themed map that supports Punch Royale.

Balance

 After throwing an object players can no longer immediately activate the magnet to juggle players.
 Punch Tank acceleration increased by 35%.
 Exploding cannonballs now weigh 40% less so players can punch them at each other.

Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug with UFO eliminations not counting. To compensate for this bug we are reducing the total number of UFO eliminations required by the season quest from 25 down to 10. Happy tractor beaming.
 Fixed a bug with tile drop speed on some game modes where tiles were only taking 5 seconds to drop instead of the intended 8 seconds.
 Fixed various crash bugs.


See you in Castle Punchington on June 24!

notes.title: Fantasy-themed Season 2 coming June 24th
notes.content:
Hail and well met, Punchies! 

We’re gearing up for a Fantasy-themed Season 2 of Rumble Club, which will launch on June 24th. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937603/87e3e2a50bd85910205c4a009c2cf54b6b816d30.png

We’ll save the full patch notes for then, of course, but here’s a sneak peak at some of what you can expect in our second season of content: 

 New way to play: Rumble Run, a grand prix style multi-round mode where only one Punchie can be crowned champion. 
 New map: Punchington Castle will support Punch Royale, Goop Cube, King of the Hill, Crab Crush, and more game modes. 
 Five new seasonal gadgets: Check out the Horsie, Sword and Board, Plunger Crossbow, Fairy Wings, and the Ogre King.
 Tons of fantasy cosmetics: Kings, Queens, Dragons, oh my!
 OTK creator cosmetics: Custom cosmetics of some of your favorite creators! 
 Changes to Rumble Pass: Gadget cards are moving from the Premium Track to the Free Track, and more cosmetics are coming to the Premium Track. 

We also want to give a HUGE thank you to the Rumble Club community - over 1 million players have jumped into the game across mobile and PC so far and we couldn’t be more grateful, truly! We hope you’re all looking forward to Season 2 on June 24th!

notes.title: Rumble Club 1.1 - Enter Gadget Game!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937603/60d2d9fc0f5d66d165944c7a08da43cd8aa671fd.png

Version 1.1 of Rumble Club has just gone live, including a brand new game mode. If you like the game’s whacky gadgets, this one’s for you! 

Introducing Gadget Game
In Rumble Club’s newest game mode, you’ve always got a Gadget at your disposal. Secure an elimination with a Gadget to automatically upgrade to another Gadget. Get 10 eliminations and win!

Play Gadget Game in the Points Mode playlist, and look for Gadget Game Only to show up as an event!

[previewyoutube=sN6ffphV_M4;full][/previewyoutube]
Here’s everything else new in Rumble Club v1.1:

 See your Quest progress on the Elimination and Match Complete screen without having to go all the way out to the main menu
 If you play in a Private Match with 16 total people, you’ll get Quest Progress
 See a bug or something fishy in a match? Go to the replay and Report it to the Development team for investigation!
 Sunset Shallows map now supports Deathmatch
 Increased the speed that you can tap through Battle Pass rewards

Balance

 Flower Pots can be thrown further and apply a strike when they explode
 TNT now applies 2 strikes when it explodes
 Ice Cubes from Ice Machine Gadgets last half as long to prevent clusters of ice cubes from piling up and creating a big mess in the area.
 Added some more holes and danger to King of the Tilt to create more exciting fights in some areas where there was not enough danger.
 Improved Item spawners on Punchie Plaza 2v2 and 4v4 to make the matches more interesting.
 Increased the movement speed but decreased the maneuverability of the starting and respawn balloon item.
 Updated the charge time for the Punch Tank. Instead of 0.75 to get to a 1 strike shot it now only takes 0.5 seconds to get to the first charge level. The second charge level is unchanged at 1.5 total seconds.

Bug Fixes

 Fixed an exploit that allowed players to drop a stunned player they are carrying
 Fixed numerous instances where Punchies could balance on rooftops
 Fixed more instances of mismatched end-game placements
 Other performance and loading improvements

Idle Anvil
The punchie overseers are watching you. If they catch you idling in a bad place on the map they will drop an anvil on your head. You have been warned.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937603/934168ec8723137ee06498df29f346f4bcdf6181.gif

notes.title: Patch notes: Rumble Club 1.0
notes.content:
We’re just a few days away from the worldwide launch of Rumble Club!  Since our playtest last month, we’ve made a few changes. 

From some highly requested new game modes to a range of fixes and balance tweaks, read on for all the details.  

And don’t forget to hop into our Discord for more updates on Rumble Club. 

Patch Notes: 
Trophy Road and Crown Road
Get rewards for earning Trophies and Crowns, including exclusive Accessories!

Event Rotation
We’ve added a permanent Goop Cube Event to the Game Mode Selector! Rotating between Duos, Trios, and Squads, you’ll always be able to play Goop Cube with a friend.

New Game Modes
We’ve added new game modes to Rumble Club that are found in Events, Private Matches, and even the Random - Free For All bucket. Check out what’s new below!

Crab Crush

 Eliminate Punchies to spawn crabs. Punch Crabs to collect them. Hold 15 crabs to win!
 Crab Crush comes in Solo, Duos, Trios, and Squads variants
 Crab Crush will appear in the Random - Free for All Playlist and in Private Matches

Deathmatch

 Deathmatch has been promoted from an Event mode to a Core mode!
 Eliminate Punchies to increase your score, first to 15 wins!
 Deathmatch comes in Solo, Duos, Trios, and Squads variants
 Crab Crush will appear in the Random - Free for All Playlist, in Event Modes, and in Private Matches

Goop Cube - Teams

 Take on another Team, last team standing wins!
 2v2 and 10v10 variants are available
 2v2 and 10v10 Goop Cube will appear in Event Modes and Private Matches
3v3 Sugar Rush

 Take on a more competitive version of Sugar Rush! The only sources of Cupcakes are a single tray or eliminating enemies, so get punching.
 3v3 Sugar Rush will appear in Event Modes and Private Matches

5 Player Sugar Rush

 Take on a more competitive version of Sugar Rush! The only sources of Cupcakes are a single tray or eliminating enemies, so get punching.
 5 Player Sugar Rush will appear in Event Modes

Map Picker Update
The Private Match map picker has been updated to be a lot easier to navigate. You can now select party size, then game mode and then map. 2v2, 10v10, 4v4, Deathmatch, and Crab Crush are now available in Private Matches

Twitch Drops and Integration

 Watch your favorite Rumble Club streams and earn rewards, including an exclusive 3D Glasses cosmetic
 Connect with Twitch to show your Twitch Name in Private Lobbies

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937603/4a6872c5ce177429560eb3b09e59a920fcfcef89.png
Balance
Goop Cube

 The goal is to make Goop Cube matches be a bit less chaotic at the end. Matches frequently ended with 10+ players all alive on a single tile, which was a little too much chaos.
 Increased Goop Cube duration from 14s->20s
 Increased Goop Cube Throw distance by 30%
 Increased the time it takes for Goop Cube maps to get down to a single tile.

Sugar Rush 

 Decreased single cupcake pickup time from 0.75s to 0.4s
 Decreased the number of cupcakes that randomly spawn from 18->14.
 Increased the number of cupcakes that spawn from an elimination from 1 to 2

Combat

 Increased the knockout time after being thrown from 0.7 to 0.8 seconds.

Gadgets

 Mailbox knockback distance increased by 20%.
 Mailbox knockback height decreased by 50%.
 Balloon Launcher now applies one strike on indirect hits and 2 strikes on direct hits.
 Umbrella knockback distance increased by 30%.
 Umbrella block reliability increased by making the block area a bit thicker.
 Drone now applies a strike on indirect hits.
 Hamster Ball now applies a strike when it lands.
 Magic Donut knockback distance increased by 20%.
 Magic Donut knockback height decreased by 20%.
 Magic Donut can no longer turn to aim while slamming.
 Punch Tank charge levels now apply 0/1/2 strikes.
 Anti-Grav Tool knockback distance increased by 50%.
 Anti-Grav Tool knockback height decreased by 60%.
 Anti-Grav Tool float power decreased to help prevent flying on low gravity maps.
 UFO pull power increased by 30%.
 Ice Machine projectile knockback reduced from 40/80/100 to 25/50/65.

Bug Fixes

 Fixed a floating spawner in SE corner of Wreckt 1v1
 Fixed a bug where the smallest asteroids would explode if you touched them even if they weren’t moving after someone else had thrown them.
 Fixed a bug where the lava rocks would explode if you touched them even if they weren’t moving after someone else had thrown them.
 Fixed “New Zones Available!” bug on Factory and Jewel of Denial in Sugar Rush
 Fixed two trees in Jewel of Denial that get cupcakes stuck on top of them when you punch them.
 Fixed a bug where Lava Rocks in eruption and Crazy Caldera were not applying strikes.

Controller Support in menus
You can now use your controller to navigate throughout all menus in the game. Lean back!
